evidence_type: STRUCTURAL (Oracle-text categories, exact hypergeometric) + qualitative audit
hypergeometric_note: on the draw, no mulligan: 7 + t cards seen by turn t

Strix Serenade.text: Counter target artifact, creature, or planeswalker spell. Its controller creates a 2/2 blue Bird.
Strix Serenade.unique_coverage: the deck's only 1-mana hard counter for CREATURE spells. Remaining creature-spell answers: Force of Will, Pact of Negation, Flare of Denial (pitch a blue creature), Mindbreak Trap (conditional), Subtlety (evoke, top/bottom), Sink into Stupor (3-mana bounce). Every remaining one costs a card, a creature, a future turn, or 4+ mana. Artifact-spell coverage stays wide (9 answers incl. FoN, Fierce Guardianship).
Strix Serenade.tournament_evidence: Geekery R3: Strix (paid with Lotho Treasure) countered Kinnan's Phyrexian Metamorph.
Strix Serenade.census: 1.1% of Oracle T&T lists / 0.5% of non-Oracle lists (DECKBUILD-008): pilot tech in both.

Volatile Stormdrake.text: Flying, hexproof from activated and triggered abilities. ETB: exchange control of this and target creature an opponent controls. If you do, you get EEEE, then sacrifice that creature unless you pay E equal to its mana value.

vs_gilded_drake.situation: target MV <= 4 (almost every cEDH engine creature: Kinnan, Thrasios, Tymna, Rograkh, Dockside, Bowmasters, Oculus, Hermit, Druid...)

vs_gilded_drake.stormdrake: steal, then sacrifice it (removal, not theft)

vs_gilded_drake.situation: target gains hexproof / is sacrificed / bounced in response
vs_gilded_drake.stormdrake: ability fizzles; you KEEP a 2-mana flyer
vs_gilded_drake.gilded_drake: 'still resolves... if you don't or can't make an exchange, sacrifice this creature' -> you lose it

vs_gilded_drake.situation: no opposing creature (e.g. cast as Pod / Chord / Neoform fodder or Cradle count)
vs_gilded_drake.gilded_drake: sacrificed (up to one target, no exchange)

vs_gilded_drake.stormdrake: a flyer with hexproof from activated and triggered abilities (harder for THEM to sacrifice/bounce with their own abilities)

Volatile Stormdrake.tutor_access: both are 2-MV blue creatures: Chord (X=2, instant), Survival (instant), Finale / Nature's Rhythm (X=2), Pod from a 1-drop, Neoform from a 1-drop, Eldritch, DT / Vampiric / Seal / Pact. Cutting Stormdrake halves the number of theft TARGETS, not the number of tutors that reach theft.
Volatile Stormdrake.one_drake_enough: with one Drake the category survives through tutors (the same ~11 tutors still reach Gilded), but a fair-floor theft card that never bricks is replaced by one that is sacrificed when there is no target and fails if the target escapes.

Colossal Skyturtle.cost: {4}{G}{G}{U} enchantment creature (7 MV) — used for its channel abilities
Colossal Skyturtle.text: Channel {2}{G}: return target card from your graveyard to your hand. Channel {1}{U}: return target creature to its owner's hand. Flying, ward {2}.

roles.instant_bounce: {1}{U}, an ACTIVATED ability from hand: cannot be hit by ordinary counterspells (Stifle effects only). The only remaining creature bounce is Otawara ({3}{U} minus legends) and Sink into Stupor ({1}{U}{U}, counterable spell).
roles.regrowth: {2}{G}: the deck's ONLY regrowth — rebuys a spent Force of Will / Pact of Negation / Silence / tutor, or a destroyed Devoted Druid / Swift / Effigy (now a measured solver delivery option under the 008b rules).
roles.pitch: blue (Force of Will, Force of Negation, Misdirection, Subtlety, Commandeer) AND green (Endurance evoke) pitch fuel.
roles.survival_typing: a creature card: Survival of the Fittest fetches it to hand at instant speed, so Survival + Skyturtle is a repeatable bounce / regrowth access line.
roles.endurance_recursion: Skyturtle can return Endurance (or anything) to hand; Endurance can put the graveyard back into the library. No deterministic win line in this deck depends on that loop; it is grind / anti-graveyard-hate value.
roles.tutor_x_caveat: Chord / Finale / Nature's Rhythm put it onto the battlefield (7 MV) — its useful modes need it in HAND (Survival, DT, Vampiric, Seal, Pact, Worldly).

Colossal Skyturtle.what_is_lost: the deck's only regrowth and its only uncounterable instant creature bounce.
